description: Ugandan intelligence allegedly procured FinFisher spyware from Gamma Group to monitor political opposition following the 'Walk to Work' protests.
Privacy International publishes detailed report 'For God and My President' detailing the deployment of FinFisher in Uganda.
Installation of hundreds of CCTV cameras with facial recognition capabilities across Kampala begins, backed by Huawei.
Total internet blackout during the general elections, preceded by targeted blocking of social media and VPNs.
Apple notifies US State Department employees in Uganda that their iPhones were targeted by NSO Group's Pegasus spyware.
Prominent investigative journalist Canary Mugume receives an Apple threat notification warning of a state-sponsored spyware attack.
Reports of activists' devices being seized and forensically extracted using UFED tools during detentions.
